notes: Trump-side licensee LLC for the Trump International Hotel Waikiki tower (Honolulu, HI). Two income components disclosed on the same form row (royalties + management fees); both captured in the edge notes per Fork G precedent of one-edge-per-row with income in notes (the schema has no income-stream interest_type; surfaced as a deviation from §4-A.3 Row 2's two-edge instruction). IRONGATE AZREP BW LLC is the external counterparty; Convention 6 defers the external entity edge. Disclosed as Part 2 Exhibit A item 71 on cp_filing_0003 (Trump 2021 termination 278). Held via The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust (cp_entity_0003) per the locked cp_filing_0003 trust-intermediate convention; subsidiary edge registered in Fork I-a.
